title: Effective coding for a fixed tape count
statement: For a natural number $k$, an effective code consists of a function assigning each Boolean string $\alpha$ a natural number $N(\alpha)$, a machine with $k$ work tapes and state set $\mathrm{Fin}(N(\alpha)+1)$ for each $\alpha$, and a finite Boolean machine called the canonizer. It also includes a natural-valued time bound for the canonizer and a proof that the canonizer computes the serialization of the machine assigned to $\alpha$ within that bound.
hypotheses_covered: A function from Boolean strings to natural numbers

The canonizer computes the specified serialization within the bound
